name: Michikusa Lodge
description: Michikusa Lodge is a quiet block theme for a trunk-road motor lodge. Every page opens on an inset window holding two film-grain photographs laid over each other, with the menu and a round amber Book tonight disc on the photo and a booking bar docked on its foot, the headline below on paper. Section headings sit on a double-hairline band; the arrival hour pairs a 4:3 photograph with stacked time lines, a circle photograph and an amber line drawing of the lodge. It continues with rooms on a hairline ledger, a full price table, a dawn breakfast band and a scroll-snap road strip. EB Garamond and Karla, film-grain photography, quiet scroll effects.
